ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (28) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Душечка» (dushechka, 'darling'), both the story's title and the heroine's nickname, is "The Darling" (in quotes where Tolstoy quotes it); the verses of Numbers 23:11–13 and 24:10–11 are translated from Tolstoy's Russian, with his chapter-and-verse form kept, and «господь» (gospod', 'Lord') is "the Lord". «Жемчужная болезнь» (zhemchuzhnaya bolezn', 'pearl disease', bovine tuberculosis) is kept literal; «господина Ата» is read as the genitive of the pen name «Ат» (At), hence "Mr. At"; «женский вопрос» (zhenskiy vopros) is "the woman question".

Source observation: [17] «господина Ата»: the feuilletonist's pen name is taken as «Ат» (At), of which «Ата» is the regular genitive; if the pen name is indeclinable «Ата», the English should read "Mr. Ata". Not a damage flag; recorded for verification.
